# Address Library for SKSE Plugins

`versionlib-1-7-104-0.bin` is from **Address Library for SKSE Plugins** by **meh321**
(https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/32444), "All in one (Anniversary Edition)" v13.
Its author allows including it in free mods with credit. It maps the plugin's address IDs to Skyrim 1.7.104.
